risk_note: RV2 (platform config and HTTP bootstrap; BR-ID-05 'IP is the client IP identified by the gateway'). New TRUSTED_PROXIES env (comma-separated IPs or CIDRs) parsed by loadConfig into AppConfig.trustedProxies; unset or empty means no forwarded header is trusted (unchanged behaviour); hop counts, true/false/*, /0, proxy-addr range names, masks, empty items and non-IP text fail start with one fixed ConfigError problem that echoes no value. bootstrap passes the list as Fastify trustProxy only when non-empty, so request.ip is the rightmost untrusted address; all callers (device registration, SMS send/login, rate limiting, request log) keep request.ip. No funds or attribution code. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
